title: Immediate versus delayed dexamethasone implantation during vitrectomy for diabetic macular edema with secondary epiretinal membrane: A retrospective comparative study

license.statement: CC BY-NC 4.0 (article <license>: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 License, SAGE); private record

condition: Pseudophakic eyes with diabetic macular edema and secondary epiretinal membrane, no prior intravitreal corticosteroid and a washout after the last anti-VEGF injection; 25-gauge pars plana vitrectomy with ERM and ILM peeling (triamcinolone-assisted, ICG staining) plus dexamethasone implant given either at the end of surgery or at 1 month; PRN dexamethasone retreatment from month 3; retrospective single-centre comparative study (People's Hospital of Leshan, 2020-2024); 12-month follow-up

groups.agent: vitrectomy with ERM/ILM peeling plus dexamethasone 0.7 mg implant (Ozurdex) at the end of surgery; PRN implants from month 3 (minimum 3-month interval)
vitrectomy with ERM/ILM peeling; first dexamethasone 0.7 mg implant (Ozurdex) at the 1-month postoperative visit; PRN implants from month 3 (minimum 3-month interval)

series.notes: mean ± SD (Table 4 footnote); times from surgery (preoperative baseline; 1, 3, 6, 9 and 12 months after surgery); all 40 eyes completed every visit with no missing observations; PRN dexamethasone re-implants from month 3 are included (values not removed)

mean ± SD (Table 4 footnote); times from surgery (preoperative baseline; 1, 3, 6, 9 and 12 months after surgery); the first implant is given at the 1-month visit; all 40 eyes completed every visit with no missing observations; PRN dexamethasone re-implants from month 3 are included (values not removed)

exclusions.reason: test statistics and p-values are not admissible

Ambiguity resolved: the two arms differ only in the timing of an approved implant and neither is declared experimental, so both groups are control.
Ambiguity resolved: regimen prn for the immediate arm (implant at surgery, then PRN) and other for the delayed arm (scheduled implant at 1 month, then PRN).
Ambiguity resolved: the Methods require a washout after the last anti-VEGF injection but do not state how many eyes had prior anti-VEGF, so prior_treatment is unstated.
